configBlock.description: Carried on the registry entry of a knob-bearing entry (the catalog pattern: the store is the source, edits write back through the one writer path, the engine reads at fire time). An entry without real knobs carries no block — honest absence, never an empty form.
configBlock.title: The entry form's config block (knob-bearing entries only)

configView.description: The entry's config block plus the store's version stamp. Saves present the version they loaded; the writer refuses a stale save (contract 04's no_match) and validates type, range, and the block's declared constraints before applying anything.
configView.title: The served config view on job detail

constraint.title: A declared cross-knob constraint the config writer enforces

knob.title: One editable config knob (descriptor + current value)

description: The served job view: contract 09's frozen field list plus the served classification (amendment 2026-11-13: audience, and for built-ins family + open_in; direct built-ins carry both as null). Job detail extends this object with the detail fields named in contract 09 and the config view (below). The run view's duration_label/detail fields are the mock's gap fields G1/G2 (contract 09 findings) — tolerated here, frozen or dropped at S8 like the rest of the gap list.

audience.description: Served classification (amendment 2026-11-13): operator = the operator's own job; builtin = the system's own machinery, rendered in the Built-in group. Never derived client-side.

family.description: A family built-in's owning pipeline family. Null for operator jobs and for direct built-ins (the app's own machinery — group placement is the whole statement, no family is served).

open_in.description: The shell-bridge navigation target a family built-in's detail offers (Open in Runner / Workbench / Attention / Dispatch). Null exactly when family is null.

title: Scheduler job view (contract 09 — GET /api/v1/jobs, /api/v1/jobs/<id>)
